runtime_semantics.PlayOnce: Play the sequence once and disable the Image after the final-frame delay.
runtime_semantics.FixLastFrame: Play once and retain the last frame.
runtime_semantics.source_note: Cycle=1 uses an effectively unbounded play count; PlayOnce=0 takes the terminal path that disables the Image; FixLastFrame=2 is the non-looping terminal path that leaves the last assigned frame visible.
runtime_semantics.host_boundary: A frame clock driven by Android elapsed time is a host scheduler adaptation. Preserve source order/FPS/cycle type; do not claim coroutine scheduling is bit-identical to Unity.

limits: Scene AnimatedImage components include UI/sign content; they do not establish that every room NPC animates.
Character emotion frame lists do not establish which character or emotion is active at a particular gameplay moment.
Door sound choices are ESound runtime values; this export does not resolve the service's enum-to-clip route.
